source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Modules use their own warn method with the calendar.loglevel option, while selected plain scripts call console.warn. Those logging calls do not replace explicit control flow: the CalDAV detector separately throws cancellation/auth/certificate or detection errors, a dangling identity lookup returns null, an invalid mode returns unchanged, and a successful backup warns with its file path. The new preference/receiver choice is not a promise that every warning aborts or that output was observed.
title: Calendar warning receiver changes remain separate from detector result control flow
